summary: Backend testing completed for Accounting Engine Integration (Motor de Contabilización). All 14 tests passed. Verified: invoice creation with automatic accounting entries, P&L report, cost center actual vs budget report, and granular permissions for invoices, payments, and fixed cost categories.
seed_data_creation: Created test invoices and payments during testing (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Accounting Engine integration is working correctly. Tests verify: POST /api/business-clarity/invoices creates revenue entries in accounting_entries, GET /api/business-clarity/reports/profit-loss returns P&L with revenue/payroll/purchases/inventory_cost, GET /api/business-clarity/reports/cost-center-actual returns actual vs budget by cost center. Permission checks are implemented and working: create invoice requires editor+ role, create payment requires finance+ role, manage fixed cost categories requires finance+ role.

invoice_creation_with_accounting_entry.details: Creates invoice and automatically records revenue in accounting_entries via AccountingEngine.record_invoice()

profit_loss_report.details: Returns P&L summary with period, revenue, payroll, expenses, purchases, inventory_cost, total_costs, gross_profit, transactions_count

cost_center_actual_report.details: Returns actual spending by cost center with budget comparison, variance, and utilization_percent

payment_creation_permission.details: Requires finance+ role (owner, admin, finance) via check_finance_permission()

invoice_creation_permission.details: Requires editor+ role (owner, admin, finance, editor) via check_edit_permission()

business_clarity_dashboard.details: Returns total_receivables, total_overdue, total_payables, aging_buckets, profit_signals
